To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the velocity distributions of the SDSS satellite galaxies are in agreement with MOND and that the anisotropy profiles of the two hosts are in agreement with the anisotropic dissipationless collapse models.

the SDSS satellite velocity distributions can be reproduced in MOND without the need of a large amount of dark matter, and that the anisotropy profile required to do so is remarkably similar to that generated by dissipation-less collapse simulations in MONM.

(i) the SDSS measured los velocity dispersions of satellite galaxies can be fitted in MOND without invoking any additional dark matter; and (ii) the radial variation of anisotropy is consistent with that of dissipationless collapse in MOND.

the SDSS satellite distribution is not in contradiction with MOND.
